title: Comparing Correcting and Reversing Entries between Dynamics SL and Dynamics 365 Business Central

chapters.title: Introduction and SL correcting entries options
Creating reversing entries in Dynamics SL
Posting the correcting entry in SL

features.name: Reverse journal entry
features.description: Capability to reverse a previously posted journal entry in Dynamics SL by selecting the reverse option which creates an unposted reversal batch that completely reverses the original posted batch with debits and credits swapped.
caveats: Only available in Dynamics SL within the journal transactions workflow

features.name: Reverse and create correcting entry
features.description: Option in Dynamics SL to reverse a journal entry and simultaneously create a correcting entry rather than just reversing or manually copying.

features.name: Copy entry for manual correction
features.description: Option in Dynamics SL to copy a journal entry to make manual changes rather than reversing it.

features.name: Reverse journal entry in Business Central
features.description: Capability to reverse a posted journal entry in Business Central through the general ledger entry window, where the system defaults the journal entry information and reverses the amounts.

features.name: Correct dimension in Business Central
features.description: Functionality to correct or add a dimension value to a posted journal entry without reversing the entire transaction, including the ability to specify the new dimension value and add missing dimensions.
